name: Slide off ice into void
description:
Player should slide off ice floor and into the void below

One Up command in a 6×6 room; expect exactly 7 ticks after Start.
Player: 1 cell, starting at (0, 5, 1). Terrain and fixtures: Ice, Limestone.

Ticks 1–4 (each tick): Player moves 1 north.
Ticks 5–6 (each tick): Player moves 1 down.
Tick 7: Player disappears.

Coordinates are (x, y, z); north decreases y. Every frame is checked in all four rotations. Unmentioned objects retain their authored positions and states.
